# Diagnostic disposable VM only; Root must prepare /var/lib/anonymous-usercopy
# as fresh root:root0700 and replace NONCE with its exact nonzero decimal nonce.
[service anonymous-usercopy]
user=root
group=root
supplementary-groups=none
umask=0077
authority-ceiling=16384
no-new-privileges=yes
service-privileges=none
exec=/usr/libexec/anonymous-usercopy-scheduled
arg=/usr/libexec/anonymous-usercopy-scheduled
arg=NONCE
depends=journald
type=oneshot
class=normal
priority=0
environment=empty
env=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib
readiness=exit-success
readiness-timeout-ms=65000
restart=never
backoff-initial-ms=250
backoff-max-ms=30000
restart-budget=1
restart-window-ms=60000
stable-run-ms=60000
stop-term-ms=2000
stop-kill-ms=1000
drain-timeout-ms=2000
stdio=journal
enable=always
